$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for AICV's three offers. Consumed by get-agent-ready.astro (visible cards + JSON-LD offers), llms.txt.ts and scripts/build-offers.mjs. Change a price HERE only, never in a page. scripts/check-pricing.mjs fails the build if any surface diverges.

tiers.name: Agent Visibility card
tiers.blurb: AICV's dated record of public facts about your business, if it has a place on a desk. Labeled Observed by AICV, with its website checked on a schedule.
tiers.llms: free, for businesses with a place on a desk: AICV-observed public facts, labeled Observed by AICV with the date recorded, and scheduled checks of the official website

tiers.name: Agent Ready
tiers.blurb: Review and approve your record, then confirm you control your domain. It becomes Verified by the business, and the desk answers from it.
tiers.llms: $500 one-time: the owner reviews and approves their record, and changes show as submitted information with identity unconfirmed. After an automatic DNS check confirms control of the business domain, the record is labeled Verified by the business and the desk answers from it. Includes a private agent-readiness review where AICV has measured the website. The check does not confirm the facts, which remain the responsibility of the business. Paying alone never changes the label, and buying does not buy a place on a desk. No annual fee. No guarantee of outside indexing or citation.

tiers.name: Consulting
tiers.blurb: Everything beyond your record. Substantial AI work for your business, scoped together.
tiers.llms: everything beyond that: book a conversation with Sat. No public price, not self-serve.
